description: Original prim mod.rs with bounded correspondence models.
state: Vertex count and ordered undirected kruskal::Edge records with u64 weights, at most one million vertices and edges. Return kruskal::Forest with original indices in Prim acceptance order.
cost: O(V+E log(E+1)) time and O(V+E) storage. Every edge is inserted at most twice; stale internal edges are charged. Limits precede allocations; allocator failures are not typed.
forward: Check limits then each edge endpoint in input order, u before v. Ignore validated loops. Visit components from smallest unvisited root. Insert incident edges in a min heap keyed by (weight,min endpoint,max endpoint,index), discard edges with both ends visited, and accept each crossing minimum into the growing tree. Sum weights in checked u128.
inverse: Let U be declared inputs crossed with returned observations and R the forward relation in model.md#approximant. C=U minus R includes wrong first errors, wrong values and forbidden results. This is an exact specification complement and partial source-derived model, not a measured global Rust complement. Accepted edges cross the visited cut and never create a cycle. Every input connected component is spanned; accepted edge count is V-components. Total weight is minimum among all forests spanning original components. Isolated vertices count as components.

Pre(y)={x in domain | R(x,y)} retains all compatible inputs. Outputs lose redundant edges and intermediate heap/pivot traces; errors retain all graphs sharing their first-failure condition. No unique recovery or inverse executor is claimed.
limitations: Finite evidence is not a general proof; allocation failures unmodeled.
Partial syntax excludes macro expansion and semantic resolution.
